architecture.initialization_rule: domain-separated seed from full condition identity and fixed initialization slot; no opportunistic substitution
architecture.permitted_contrasts: Within the identical teacher seed, phase, and condition, alternate-architecture student-cell median minus canonical-architecture student-cell median; aggregate only complete pairs over teacher seeds. Architecture results are conditional external-validity contrasts, not isolated causal effects of depth, heads, or width.

tier2_assignment.unavailable_rule: retain unavailable; no seed or checkpoint replacement

model_roles_per_checkpoint: lowest fixed eligible canonical hard student
lowest fixed eligible canonical soft student
assignment.unavailable_rule: retain unavailable and compare only exact checkpoint pairs; no replacement

basis.attention_refinement: each coordinate of blocks.{layer}.attn.hook_z before W_O is a component; zero in that coordinate system
basis.canonical: attention heads plus individual MLP neurons with activation zeroing

mlp_blocks.policy: balanced canonical-order partition after a deterministic Fisher-Yates permutation

basis.permitted_contrasts: For the same model/checkpoint, discovery method, phase, condition, and teacher seed, compare each alternative-basis Endpoint 1 and packing reduction with its canonical-basis reduction. Aggregate paired differences by teacher seed; raw component counts are never compared without raw, parameter-weighted, and component-type denominators.

rotations.algorithm: float64 Gaussian matrix, QR, positive diagonal sign convention, then cast to model dtype
rotations.intervention: rotate, zero declared coordinates, inverse rotate
rotations.subspace: each eligible layer MLP post-activation vector

calibration.certificate: exhaustive feasible inventory hash plus exact Endpoint 1 and maximum-compatible-subset proof
calibration.exactness: every mask has one sealed exact fidelity record and the inventory count/hash matches 262144
calibration.mask_universe: 2 attention heads plus 16 individual MLP neurons
calibration.transfer_limit: calibrates procedure behavior only on this small instance; no automatic main-scale error bound

discovery.backend_determinism: Stage 14 must qualify the actual CPU/CUDA/MPS backend. MPS has no presumed authority; a school-Mac MPS class becomes eligible only after exact and semantic qualification on that class, otherwise its qualified MPS throughput is zero and CPU is used.
discovery.exact_allowance_semantics: 256 total exact evaluations per model-method ledger, including the mandatory intact mask; duplicate requests reuse evidence and do not recharge the ledger
failure_rules: nonfinite optimization is terminal numerical failure
budget exhaustion is censored, not success
interruption resumes from a hash-bound checkpoint
discovery.intact_mask: always included and exactly evaluated so Endpoint 1 is defined up to 1.0

methods.termination: all ranked proposals consumed, exact allowance exhausted, or explicit failure

endpoints.censoring_rule: budget exhaustion or incomplete candidate inventory is procedure-censored
endpoints.failure_rule: retain zero from valid empty qualification; distinguish solver/search failure from zero
endpoints.overlap_metric: Jaccard overlap of retained components in the declared basis

sensitivity_grid.execution: reducer-only from masks and exact fidelities already present in each sealed ledger; no rediscovery, new model inference, new exact evaluation, or ledger mutation

hierarchy.key_secondary: packing at component cap 0.25 and maximum Jaccard overlap 0.25

sensitivity_grid.ledger_limit: if a mask is absent from the sealed ledger, no sensitivity cell may generate or evaluate it

endpoints.solver: exact maximum compatible subset with lexicographically smallest mask-identity tuple tie-break

fidelity.accumulation_order: canonical example order then class order
fidelity.denominator_guard: denominator exactly zero is undefined and rejected; every positive finite denominator is valid
fidelity.ledger_reuse: reducer-only for all masks already present; never duplicate a discovery job

combinatorial.matching: exact retained size and component-type counts
combinatorial.replacement: independent seeded draws with duplicates retained and reported

local_perturbation.seed_masks: up to four lexicographically first exactly qualified masks

ordinary_restart.exact_allowance_semantics: 256 total including intact in Package A/C; 128 total including intact in Package B
ordinary_restart.method: same discovery family without diversity pressure or packing-aware feedback

model_roles: lowest fixed eligible canonical hard student
lowest fixed eligible canonical soft student

nulls.undercoverage: report layer as incomplete/unavailable; do not impute or collapse

optional_tier3_attempt_policy.derivation: approved lowest-eligible singular roster and approved 20/30/40 attempt projection

population_and_tasks.matched_primary_rule: teacher seed must have both primary phase landmarks; the 50% cell may be absent without invalidating the primary pair

optional_task_common_panel.population_interpretation: tasks are not independent population replicates; report task-indexed descriptive external validity

population_and_tasks.replacement_rule: no replacement of task, teacher seed, phase, or failed training/student slot beyond its existing fixed cap

task4.justification: an asymmetric separable polynomial with unequal degrees and no interaction term; unlike subtraction, it is not a linear relabelling of Task 1, and unlike Task 2/3 it is neither bilinear nor homogeneous quadratic

task5.justification: a homogeneous degree-3 coupled interaction with no pure monomials; it differs from separable Task 4, degree-2 Task 3, and single-monomial multiplication

population_and_tasks.teacher_training: canonical predecessor architecture and configs/model.yaml plus configs/training.yaml, trained from scratch for at most 40000 updates

hard.eligibility: exact argmax agreement on every input

students_and_training.replacement_rule: none outside the predeclared attempt slots
students_and_training.stop_rule: stop after eligible target is reached or all fixed slots resolve; retain every earlier failure
